property_summary: For every input, the reference contract's paused() view returns the actual internal _paused flag (i.e. equals c.paused() == (address(c).balance, but more simply: paused() matches the internal flag set by _pause/_unpause); the mutant inverts the returned boolean so for some admissible sequence the returned value differs — we assert that immediately after initialization paused() == false, which the mutant will violate because it returns true.
change_summary: Change paused() to return the negation of the internal _paused flag so callers observe inverted paused state.
